scope: Complete pinned-corpus correctness replay through the production source planner and actual parser workers; two serial arms. Every unchanged chunk field is compared by typed structural SHA-256; only media transport is normalized to row/path columns, exact diagnostic arena, fallback rows and source order. Timing fields and the callback-local release function are excluded. No persistence, browser timing, or peak-memory claim.

interruptions.stage: Baseline completed and checkpointed; interrupted while starting candidate arm
interruptions.effect: No candidate comparison completed in the interrupted process; candidate resumes from verified baseline receipt in a new process
